original_test_intent: Verify all expected HIB switch 1 through N ODTEMP sensors are correctly mapped and their temperature values, units, status and thresholds are human-readable and match the vendor thermal specification.
original_method: Resolve the vendor meaning and physical sensing location of ODTEMP, enumerate every expected HIB switch channel and immutable raw/UI identity, collect complete temperature/unit/status/threshold metadata with synchronized ambient, board, fan and power context, and compare raw and WebUI results to the owner specification.
manual_activity: The owner defines ODTEMP, HIB topology, sensing locations and thermal limits; an operator verifies raw/UI readability and physical correlation, and the owner adjudicates anomalies.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/firmware and HIB switch 1..N hardware inventory
Vendor definition of ODTEMP and physical sensor location per HIB
HIB-to-SDR/Redfish/UI mapping and temperature unit/scale/threshold/range specification
UI refresh/rounding/sensor-lag tolerance, protected access and evidence/redaction policy
safety_requirements: Keep the check read-only and passive; never heat/cool the system or change fan, threshold or thermal policy
Use protected authentication and complete non-truncated enumeration
Bind each reading to a physical HIB and synchronized thermal context
Preserve logs and stop/escalate on overtemperature, alarm, impossible/stale value, missing/duplicate mapping or cooling fault
Do not retry after manipulating airflow or load
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate and verify the complete HIB ODTEMP population and physical mappings
Collect complete raw values, units, status, thresholds, identities and timestamps with passive context
Assist with synchronized WebUI capture and approved unit/rounding normalization
Report missing, extra, stale, alarm or raw/UI/context/spec mismatches for owner verdict
Perform no thermal stimulus or independent DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Supply authoritative ODTEMP definition, HIB mapping and thermal limits
Review physical/context and raw/UI discrepancies or alarms

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool may expose a raw record, but a literal HIB_SW_1~N name and head-limited fallback cannot establish ODTEMP semantics, all HIBs, physical mapping, complete thresholds or UI/context consistency.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely enumerate the full SDR/Redfish inventory, select all owner-mapped HIB ODTEMP records, capture full metadata and synchronized passive thermal/fan/power context, then correlate WebUI rows to the vendor specification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: HIB_SW_1~N_ODTEMP scope, WebUI path, reading/threshold/spec comparison and 1/0-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH PACKAGE-GATED HIB SWITCH ODTEMP VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-HIB matrix containing physical switch and sensing location, raw temperature/unit/status/threshold, passive thermal/fan/power context and UI display, with population and specification results.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds vendor sensor semantics and physical thermal mapping while replacing insecure/truncated reads, log clearing and any implication of active stimulation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A plausible temperature cannot prove ODTEMP meaning or cover HIB switch 1..N. Every expected mapped sensor and threshold must be reconciled.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: ODTEMP is vendor-specific and may mean on-die, over-temperature detector or another OEM quantity; no generic Celsius interpretation is valid until the owner specification identifies it.

project_override_considerations: If ODTEMP is discrete or encoded rather than a linear temperature, the owner must provide its enumeration and acceptance semantics; the source row remains intact and must not be silently converted to a generic temperature test.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and SUT/BMC/firmware/HIB topology/vendor spec revision
ODTEMP definition and per-HIB physical sensing-location/raw/UI identity matrix
Complete raw value/unit/status/threshold/entity/timestamp plus passive ambient/board/fan/power context
Synchronized WebUI screenshots and approved scaling/rounding/lag comparison
Per-HIB discrepancies, no-stimulus/no-write/no-log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria coherently request HIB ODTEMP sensor validation. The undefined OEM acronym and mapping require package input but do not create contradictory source instructions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Vendor definition, HIB mapping, thermal specification and complete raw/UI/context evidence gate execution while static review remains complete.

review_improvement: Prevents generic-temperature assumptions by requiring the vendor ODTEMP definition, sensing location and complete per-HIB passive evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The ODTEMP label alone does not reveal whether the channel is an analog die temperature, a discrete overtemperature condition or another OEM encoding. Applying Celsius thresholds before resolving that semantic could produce a false verdict. Even if analog, location and thermal lag determine how it relates to inlet, board and fan context. The review therefore preserves the source while making vendor definition and physical mapping hard execution gates.
